The '''Living Bow''' is a type of [[Weapons|Weapon]] created from a multitude of parasite materials.

== ''Usage'' ==
'''Fighting'''
The Living Bow is one of currently 2 ranged weapons, the other being its successor. Each second the bow is pulled, 1 bonus point is added to the base value (1) up to a cap of 3 overall points. After the shot is released, the damage of the arrow itself will be multiplied with the stacked bonus points, resulting in a maximum of around 21 to 33 damage after only 2 seconds drawtime. 

This can further be amplified by the Power enchantment, adding velocity to the arrow by falling for example, as well as using tipped arrows. Combining the 3 allows for singular attacks to deal between 50 and 90 damage.

Arrows fired by the Living Bow inflict [[Bleeding|Bleeding I]] and [[Concussive Smoke Trail]] for ten seconds each, unaffected by draw length.

'''Evolving'''
As of version 1.9.20, Evolution does not take place for the bow, which seems to be a bug.
